Prompt.title: Prompt
Prompt.description: An AI prompt entry stored in the public beginner prompt repository.

title.description: Prompt title shown on cards and in the detail modal.

category.description: Prompt category (e.g., 사진 합성, 스타일 변환, 캐릭터·포스터).

content.description: Full prompt text preserving line breaks, brackets, and numbering (supports >1,000 chars).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the prompt was created, used for chronological ordering.

/prompts/{promptId}.description: Public beginner AI prompt collection ordered chronologically by createdAt.
